svg.title: A market stack, opened up
svg.desc: The foundation, stack-local resources and external dependencies occupy different scopes. This cutaway names the resources that a market can select instead of treating the stack as an empty destination.
svg.text: A logical capability anatomy; optional resources are selected, not created for every market.
Cloud-side optional: PluginInstallation · PDC network / token · frontend App · product activation singletons
Each domain uses its declared scoped provider: instance, organization or product. Logical ownership, not network placement.
Market IdP and Team Sync inputs
One writer for the complete rule set
Real queries, targets and origins required
Specialist APIs also cover project content, existing-stack consumption, promotion ladders and observe-only inventory.
IdP registrations · secret manager · cloud trust · PDC agents · collectors · private probes / load zones · workload telemetry
Orange boundary: core organization-plane foundation. Grey compartments: selectable market and product capability families.
